in_hebrew.name: Elsy

in_hebrew.long_meaning: Elsy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Elsy was the name of the goddess who presided over groves, trees, and elms. She was a protector of children and fertility.

in_latin.name: Elsy
in_latin.meaning: A shortened form of Elizabeth, meaning 'God is my oath' or 'God is my promise'
in_latin.long_meaning: Elsy, a diminutive form of Elisabeth, originates from the Hebrew name Elisheva, composed of 'El' (God) and 'Sheva' (oath or promise), conveying the idea of a solemn vow or commitment to God. In the Christian tradition, Elisabeth is a revered figure, mother of John the Baptist and cousin of the Virgin Mary, demonstrating unwavering faith and devotion. This name has been used throughout history in various cultures, symbolizing faithfulness, loyalty, and spiritual maturity.
